title: Definition
description: A game definition (`game.yml`) and the building blocks the resolved server spec reuses. YAML keys keep their snake_case spelling (`options_from`, `admin_only`); the panel validates against this at source sync (M3) and resolves `extends` and `{{…}}` templates before anything reaches an agent.

GameDefinition.description: One `game.yml`, as written in a source repo.

id.description: Slug, equal to the folder name.

extends.description: Id of another definition in the same source. Lists merge by `key`/`name`; scalars override.

image.description: Container image, may use templates (`ionnet-gss-minecraft-server:java{{vars.java}}`). Default: inherited, else `ionnet-gss-base`.

packages.description: apt packages (Debian names, optional `:i386`, at most 50). The agent builds `FROM <image>` + `apt-get install --no-install-recommends` once per (image, sorted list) and caches it as `ionnet-gss-derived:<hash16>`; the panel validates the names, the agent re-validates.

start.description: Command line run through `/bin/sh -c`. String and secret variables and `server.name` must use the `sh` filter here (`{{vars.motd|sh}}`).

install_timeout.description: Seconds the whole install may take before it is cancelled (`install_failed`). Default is INIT_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_SEC (2 hours).

services.description: Extra containers of a stack, keyed by the host name the game reaches them under (`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,30}$`, at most 4). On the server's bridge only, never published, started before the game (waiting for `healthcheck`), stopped after it, removed with it.

VariableBind.description: Resource limit a variable sets; the value counts against the owner's quota.

pattern.description: `string` and `select`: RE2 the whole value must match; the fallback check for `options_from` selects when the list can't be fetched.

admin_only.description: Only admins see and change it.

generate.description: `secret` only: generate this many characters once at create; never shown.

OptionsSource.description: A dynamic `select` list fetched by the panel (never by a host or a hook): GET `url` (https, host on OPTIONS_FETCH_HOSTS, ≤ 2 MiB JSON, 10 s, cached OPTIONS_CACHE_MIN), take the array at `items`, keep entries whose fields equal `where`, map each to `value`, keep those matching `include`, optionally reverse, cut to `limit`. Static `options` are listed first (e.g. `latest`). If the fetch fails, a submitted value is accepted when it matches the variable's `pattern`.

items.description: Dotted path to the array in the response, e.g. `versions`. Empty = the response is the array.

value.description: Dotted path inside each item, e.g. `id`. Empty = the item itself (arrays of strings).

where.description: Item field (dotted path) → required string value, e.g. `{ type: release }`.

reverse.description: Reverse the order (newest last in the source).

limit.description: At most this many options. Default 100, max 500.

default.description: Preferred port when it is free in the host's pool.

internal.description: Not published on the host; only reachable inside the server's network.

InstallStep.description: One install step. Exactly one key is set; its name is the step type. A new step type is a new property here plus an executor in agent/internal/initd/steps/.

hook.description: Path of a hook script in the definition folder, run as uid 1000 in /data.

app.description: Steam app id, e.g. 4020 for Garry's Mod.

dir.description: Install folder below /data. Default is /data itself. steamcmd itself lives in INIT_STEAMCMD_DIR (per server, never shared).

to.description: Target folder below /data. Default is /data itself.

ConfigFormat.description: How `set` keys are applied. properties/cfg: literal keys; ini: `section.key` (no dot = top of file); json/yaml: dotted path. A new format is a value here plus an applier in agent/internal/initd/configs/.

ConfigMapping.description: Managed keys in one config file. Only these keys are touched before every start; the rest stay the user's.

template.description: `template` format, in game.yml: path of the template file in the definition folder.

content.description: `template` format, resolved: the rendered whole file. Set by the panel, never in game.yml.

HookDecl.description: Lifecycle hooks (paths in the definition folder). Install hooks are `install` steps.

log.description: Regular expression (RE2) matched against console output; the first match moves `starting` to `running`.

StopSpec.description: Send `command` to the console, or `signal` to the process, then SIGKILL after `timeout`.

signal.description: e.g. `SIGINT`. Default is SIGTERM when no command is set.

RconSpec.description: `rcon` input. Strings, because they are templates in game.yml (`{{ports.rcon}}`).

PlayersSpec.description: Console patterns (RE2 syntax: gss-init matches them in Go, on output lines with ANSI codes stripped) whose first capture group is the player name. Validation refuses a pattern without a capture group.

before.description: Console commands sent before the archive is taken.

exclude.description: Paths below /data, relative, `/`-separated; a trailing slash means a folder; `*` and `?` match within one path segment (`logs/`, `cache/`, `*.log`, `world/session.lock`). Applies to data/ only, never to service volumes.

ServiceSpec.description: One extra container of a stack. Images are admin-trusted (they come from a source). Same hardening as the game container (CapDrop ALL plus what the image needs, no Docker socket, no published ports, the server's egress rules).

volume.description: Container path persisted at <server>/services/<name> on the host.

ServiceHealthcheck.description: Docker healthcheck (CMD-SHELL). The game starts only after it reports healthy, or fails the start after `startTimeout`.

startTimeout.description: Seconds the game waits for healthy. Default 120.

ServiceLimits.description: Per-service limits. Optional in game.yml (defaults 512 MB, 500 millis, 256 pids); always set by the panel in a resolved spec. They count toward the server's quota usage.
